title: Bug: is_dpu method was removed from SonicHost and corresponding call of is_dpu requires update
author: xixuej
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

PR #19313 remove is_dpu method from class SonicHost, but there're still tests that depend on is_dpu method. We need to update the tests that depend on is_dpu method to use ansible facts instead.

see [tests/common/platform/device_utils.py#L1150-L1164](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/aaf14da714f92fcdbff9248b0e9609ac08f08068/tests/common/platform/device_utils.py#L1150-L1164)
and [tests/platform_tests/api/test_watchdog.py#L140](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/aaf14da714f92fcdbff9248b0e9609ac08f08068/tests/platform_tests/api/test_watchdog.py#L140)

### Steps to Reproduce

Run tests with command like below

```
python3 -m pytest platform_tests/api/test_watchdog.py ...
```

we got errors like **AttributeError: '<class 'tests.common.devices.sonic.SonicHost'>' object has no attribute 'is_dpu'**

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

actual behavior: tests failed
expected behavior: test pass

linkedPullRequests.title: Refactor DPU check in device_utils and test_watchdog
linkedPullRequests.author: xixuej
linkedPullRequests.body:
This changes is because is_dpu method was removed
by below PR
[smartswitch]: Add is_smartswitch and is_dpu facts to simplify platform-specific test handling (#19313)

The way to check if is dpu should use `duthost.dut_basic_facts()['ansible_facts']['dut_basic_facts'].get("is_dpu")` instead of `duthost.get_facts().get('is_dpu')` becasue PR #19313 added the facts into dut_basic_facts
